steps.text: Attackers probe externally facing WordPress sites for the chained vulnerabilities.

steps.title: Chained exploitation (CVE-2026-60137 + CVE-2026-63030)
steps.text: The two vulnerabilities are chained to exploit the public-facing application.
steps.description: The two vulnerabilities are chained to exploit the public-facing application.

steps.title: Successful takeover (behavioral)
steps.text: Behavioral indicators of takeover follow: anomalous successful admin sessions, unexpected content changes and outbound connections. Specific post-exploitation techniques are not asserted due to sparse public evidence.
steps.description: Behavioral indicators of takeover follow: anomalous successful admin sessions, unexpected content changes and outbound connections. Specific post-exploitation techniques are not asserted due to sparse public evidence.

steps.title: Detect exploitation attempts
steps.text: Blue team detects anomalous request bursts and exploitation signatures against the WordPress attack surface.
steps.description: Blue team detects anomalous request bursts and exploitation signatures against the WordPress attack surface.

steps.title: Detect post-takeover anomalies (behavioral)
steps.text: Blue team correlates successful admin sessions, content changes and outbound connections as behavioral takeover indicators.
steps.description: Blue team correlates successful admin sessions, content changes and outbound connections as behavioral takeover indicators.

steps.title: Contain and remediate
steps.text: SOC patches the vulnerabilities, isolates affected sites, resets credentials and restores from known-good backups.
